state:
Goal `tools-cli`: two features of `docs/reference/tools/10-cli.md` now have all their proofs.
`tools:cli/files-extensions-and-tags` has a conformance case, one example and one attack, and the
chapter's `#!` bullet now says what the binary does (`rule:tooling/shebang-opens-code-mode`).
`tools:cli/nvs-api-diff` has `covers:` markers in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/openapi.rs`, a new test for a
document nested past the JSON reader's limit, one example and one attack. Neither proof found a bug in
the binary. `bun nv proofs --owed | grep tools:cli` lists the eleven features still owed; four of them
also owe `help`.

items.text: **`tools:cli/nvs-ast`** — owes examples, help, hostile, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `docs/reference/tools/10-cli.md:367`. It also owes `help`: check what `nvs agent find ast` returns before you write anything.

backlog: A tool's example and attack are programs run by `nvs run`. When the feature is a command, run the command on that program by hand and write the result in a comment. The `nvs-api-diff` example shows the shape (`docs/examples/tools/cli/nvs-api-diff/`).
`?>` inside a `//` comment does not leave code mode. PHP leaves code mode there. No case pins this, and the reference chapter does not mention it (`rule:statements/nvs-is-the-only-open-tag`).

The remaining owed features, in chapter order: `one-binary`, `nvs-run`, `nvs-check`, `nvs-test`, `nvs-build-compile`, `nvs-build-openapi`, `nvs-config-check-and-nvs-config-dump`, `the-compile-cache` (`bun nv proofs --owed`).
